post.author: Ammad Ahmed
post.headline: .NET & Full Stack Developer | C# | React | Web & Game Development
text: My university portal doesn't look like yours. 👀
I just redesigned the Bahria University portal, and every student on every campus can use it.

comments.name: Yusra Tariq
comments.role: AI Product Engineer | Building AI Applications & Intelligent Workflows for Startups | Sharing What I Build
comments.quote: This is a great example of solving a real problem students deal with every day. Love how you've gone beyond just redesigning the UI and added practical features like attendance planning, deadline tracking, and notifications. The privacy-first approach is a big plus too. Great work!

comments.name: Engr Muhammad sameer
comments.quote: Proud to see someone from among us getting praised for solving something we all struggled with but never took the step to fix.❤

comments.name: Muaaz Rizwan
comments.role: Senior Associate @ Khosa Law Chambers | Bachelor of Laws - LLB
comments.quote: Great example of turning a real user problem into a practical technology solution. What I find particularly interesting is how this project combines user experience, automation, and privacy-focused design to make everyday academic tasks easier. The best innovations are not always the most complicated ones. Sometimes, they come from understanding people's daily challenges and building simple tools that make a meaningful difference. Impressive initiative and great work bringing this idea to life
